method.native_selection: Read-only CLI with Skill only; expected skill sets are required subsets, negatives require no Go skills. Trigger identifiers are zero-based indices in evals/evals.json.
method.application: Only prompt fields were given to Claude. The parent manually assessed full answers against the final assertions; assertions and expected answers were withheld from the evaluated model.
method.explicit_application: Final phase prefixes each unchanged user prompt with Read and apply <snapshot>/skills/<owner>/SKILL.md and its relevant references. This is separate from automatic selection.
controls: Skill only for selection; Skill,Read,Glob,Grep for application
method.snapshot_hash: SHA256 of sorted relative-file-name + NUL + file SHA256 + newline over all snapshot files.
